agreement: Runtime Interaction and RouteDecision are host-owned public-neutral projections, not a second Necronomicon store or registry.
Run is a correlation envelope over current ComputeJob, GoalWorkspace, DelegationPacket, TaskWorkspace, Dispatch Spec, and artifact owners.
v0 is infrastructure-only; the first product acceptance is the executable two-child browser witness.
RouteDecision is immutable; outcomes and transitions are append-only.
Routing quality requires named fixtures, a labeled corpus, confusion evidence, asymmetric error costs, and bounded attention overhead.

resolved_conflicts.issue: Meaning of Necronomicon authority in the consumer runtime
resolved_conflicts.resolution: Necronomicon contributes admitted routing precedent only; ResonantOS owns runtime projections and revalidates every route against current host authorities.

closed_by: targeted child clarification and no-bleed assertions
labeled corpus, confusion matrix, asymmetric costs, and measurable overhead
separate Interaction, foreground Run, and child Run cardinalities
legal terminal, cancellation, and resume transitions
